rules.statement: the validation report always shows, in the listed form: the format used; pass/fail with the negative-list result plus both structural thresholds; the validator's Structural signals table including the two non-gating rows; Delta labelled informational; every out-of-range metric; every negative-list hit verbatim with line numbers; Layer 3 stances split grounded vs extrapolated
imitate the exemplar's document shape (opening, headings, lists, ending) but never its topic, wording, or sentence-level phrasing; filling its sentence templates with new nouns is copying wording
a low Delta is not evidence the voice landed: report the number and never present it as vouching for the draft

excluded.statement: the validator is the only pass/fail authority on whether a draft is in voice
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: compliance-cost rule the agent rationalizes under pressure

excluded.statement: pick the format (technical-writing, code-review, notes); state the picked format in the report
excluded.reason: technique: how-to selection rule with no competing artifact shape; the stated-format report element is exercised inside the report-composition entry

excluded.statement: load the seven voice-profile files for the chosen format before drafting
excluded.reason: technique: how-to loading guidance, no competing shape

excluded.statement: hit Layer 1's mean sentence length and its sentence-length variance
excluded.reason: technique: numeric conditioning guidance, no competing artifact shape

excluded.statement: use Layer 2's named patterns for openings, transitions, and argument structure
excluded.reason: technique: applied or not, no competing shape

excluded.statement: draw stances from Layer 3 only where the topic calls for them; track each one used and its grounded/extrapolated tag
excluded.reason: technique; the grounded/extrapolated split lands inside the report-composition entry's markers

excluded.statement: treat Layer 4 absences and the entire negative list as hard constraints; rewrite any sentence that seems to need a listed tell
excluded.reason: technique: writing-time guidance with no competing shape

excluded.statement: take every product, service, and system name from the user's request
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: under pressure to supply plausible names the agent invents them

excluded.statement: run the validator; never substitute your own judgment for its result
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: compliance-cost rule rationalized under pressure

excluded.statement: on failure, surface the full validator output and stop; leave iterating to the user
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: the tempting violation is silently iterating to green

excluded.statement: a clean validator run is necessary, not sufficient; read the draft for rule-of-three lists, inline-header bullets, and category-5 sourcing before handing it over
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: extra compliance pass rationalized away under pressure

excluded.statement: the exemplars are synthetic, written to demonstrate the shape cards; they are not the author's text
excluded.reason: retrieval-testing track: documented fact; its prescriptive half duplicates the exemplar-shape-not-wording pattern rule

excluded.statement: title-case headings and empty sections do not gate; read those two rows yourself
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: compliance-cost rule rationalized under pressure

excluded.statement: exit status 2 means the install is incomplete; tell the user rather than guessing at targets
excluded.reason: retrieval-testing track: documented operational fact, no artifact shape at stake

excluded.statement: this skill never edits voice-profile/; profile updates go through the updating-voice-profile skill
excluded.reason: pressure-testing track: hard scope constraint rationalized away under pressure
